scope: fresh edition publication, source and watchlist discovery, independent live QA, rating-contract repair and final verification
resource_policy: Plus Work/Codex allowance and built-in premium image generation only; no paid API, added credits, overage, top-up, upgrade or alternate account

failed_attempts.evidence: The local bundle executable was unavailable. Promotion remained blocked until repository CI completed its deterministic Jekyll build successfully.
The first post-commit suite exposed a stale hard-coded September 12 date in the daily-feed test. The test now derives the staged edition date and all 107 tests pass.

The first live audit found an extra x-rating-revision request header and misleading same-session change behavior. Repair PR #89 restored the exact rating transport and one-rating-per-browser behavior.

Thirty-three of forty-nine registered watchlist sources returned candidate links; five were unavailable, four yielded no candidate links, and seven require assisted review. Eight verified topics were retained with original dates.

The owner-only Command Center required an interactive ChatGPT sign-in that was not available to this non-interactive run. Usage recording, private aggregate snapshot, owner priorities, and 90-day comment cleanup were not invoked, and no indirect fallback was attempted.

usage.reason: The platform did not provide edition-attributed credit or dollar data and the owner-authenticated private usage endpoint could not be reached without an interactive sign-in.
